levels.surface: محمد بن عمرو بن عباد بن جبلة بن أبي رواد

notes: Two taḥwīl branches («ح» after «محمد بن جعفر»); the text writes shaykh Shu'ba, Khalid, Abd al-Rahman and his father once, after the last «ح»: they are the shared tail.
«محمد بن جعفر» (branch 1) and «غندر» (branch 2) are the same man in the Muslim tradition, but the text does not say so: kept as written, not merged (rule 9).
«أبيه» with no name is the Companion Abu Bakra's relation: a relation link; the Prophet is the end.
